meta.parties: Jane Young v. Loku Nona Et Al

rules.statement: The Roman-Dutch rule prohibiting requests by a man to a woman with whom he has lived in adultery is not authoritative in Ceylon.
rules.supporting_quote: 'In the Privy Council the judgment proceeded upon somewhat different grounds, and it may be contended that the judgment applies only in cases where a valid marriage had been subsequently contracted between the persons who had lived in adultery. But the language of the last paragraph of the judgment, in my opinion, goes further, and supports the view taken in the Ceylon Courts, that the Roman-Dutch rule with regard to the effects of adultery is not authoritative in Ceylon.'
